-- Automatically executes your -gh sword command 
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.6) -- Wait for the script interface to finish setting up
    local command = "-gh 4458601937 4506945409 4794315940 4820152700 4315489767 4524991457"
    
    -- Triggers chat for modern games
    local tcs = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    if tcs and tcs.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        pcall(function() tcs.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(command) end)
    end
    
    -- Triggers chat for legacy games
    local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local legacy = rep:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and rep.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
    if legacy then
        pcall(function() legacy:FireServer(command, "All") end)
    end
end)
